candidate_gaps: ACTUAL_REPORT_NOT_HELD: section 1-102 requires a report within 30 days of September 20, 1979, but no held source establishes the actual report submission date, extension, completed investigation, or termination of board service. The deadline is not evidence of performance.

REPORT_DEPENDENT_END: section 1-103 extends the statutory no-change period for 30 days after the actual report, with changes allowed by agreement. Without the report and relevant agreement/extension record, neither its first end nor the last clause end can be dated. September 20 plus 60 days and August 17, 1982 cleanup are not substitutes.

RESIDUALS_AND_COUNTEREVIDENCE: the complete original and formal revoker have no express independent post-termination directive or saving, but completion/settlement records are absent. Numbered-EO catalog and saved-text searches identify formal revocation only and do not establish the actual board report or agreement-sensitive sequence; those missing actual events prevent closure of savings and bounded counterevidence.
specific_review_qualifications: Railway Labor Act section 10 (45 USC 160) is expressly invoked by the original and not independently read as controlling statutory text in this dossier. Retain this concrete statutory/residual scope issue within savings_residuals=null; formal EO revocation alone does not prove termination of any independently operative statutory obligation. The candidate general residual gap should not be read as resolving that issue.

An agreement or extension is a relevant possibility, not an assumed event or a mandatory missing document in every lifecycle. A report occurrence is necessary to compute this original actual-report-dependent period; evidence must determine which agreements, if any, mattered.
The 1982 inactive-or-no-longer-necessary recital is not proof of first cessation. Current-law numeric searches and the named-party held corpus do not establish universal absence of earlier events.

The candidate later_source_search remains empty and the claim remains partial. The independent named-search record supports this review but is not represented as a completed producer search field or an exhaustive history.

The frozen rationale refers to erroneous earlier machine actor/date bindings. The current claim-kit dossier read here has one EO12379 chain event, and current draft proposals show only the revocation; that process narrative is not relied upon as a legal finding.
unsupported_state_or_date_scope: No unsupported asserted EO-derived state or date within the narrow partial scope. Actual first ends, whole-order end, statutory residual effects and complete closure remain explicitly unadjudicated.
